```{r}
# setup

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(forecast)
library(randomForest)
library(Metrics)
library(corrplot)
library(gridExtra)
library(reshape2)

select   <- dplyr::select
filter   <- dplyr::filter
mutate   <- dplyr::mutate
summarise <- dplyr::summarise
rename   <- dplyr::rename
arrange  <- dplyr::arrange

# code styling
while (!is.null(dev.list())) dev.off()

# Palette
PAL <- list(
  rooms  = c("#2C7BB6","#F46D43","#1A9641","#984EA3",
             "#FF7F00","#A65628","#F781BF","#999999","#E41A1C"),
  models = c(Naive="#AAAAAA", SARIMAX="#F46D43", RF="#1A9641")
)

# Room dictionary
ROOMS <- tibble(
  id     = 1:9,
  name   = c("Kitchen","Living Room","Laundry",
             "Home Office","Bathroom","Garage/North",
             "Bedroom 1","Bedroom 2","Parents Room"),
  T_col  = paste0("T", 1:9),
  RH_col = paste0("RH_", 1:9),
  indoor = c(TRUE,TRUE,TRUE, TRUE,TRUE,FALSE, TRUE,TRUE,TRUE)
)

```



 MODULE 1 LOAD DATA


```{r}

df <- read_csv("/Users/prithwirajchatterjee/Downloads/energydata_complete.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
df$date <- parse_date_time(df$date, orders = c("ymd HMS","ymd HM","ymd"))
df <- df %>% arrange(date) %>% drop_na(date)

cat(sprintf("Rows   : %d\n", nrow(df)))
cat(sprintf("Period : %s → %s\n",
            format(min(df$date), "%Y-%m-%d"),
            format(max(df$date), "%Y-%m-%d")))

cat("\n─ Sensor Summaryn")
cat(sprintf("%-14s %-12s %-10s %-12s %s\n",
            "Room","T mean °C","T std","RH mean %","Indoor?"))
cat(strrep("-", 58), "\n")
for (i in 1:9) {
  r <- ROOMS[i,]
  cat(sprintf("%-14s %-12.1f %-10.1f %-12.1f %s\n",
              r$name,
              mean(df[[r$T_col]]),
              sd(df[[r$T_col]]),
              mean(df[[r$RH_col]]),
              ifelse(r$indoor, "yes", "NO — excluded")))
}
cat(sprintf("%-14s %-12.1f %-10.1f %-12.1f %s\n",
            "Outside", mean(df$T_out), sd(df$T_out), mean(df$RH_out), "—"))
cat("\n NOTE: T6 (Garage) avg = 7.9°C ≈ outdoor — excluded from occupancy\n\n")
```

MODULE 2  EDA
```{r}

# 2A. All indoor room temperatures for the first 2 weeks
indoor_T_cols <- ROOMS$T_col[ROOMS$indoor]   # T1..T5, T7..T9 (not T6)

temp_long <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(date, all_of(indoor_T_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "T_col", values_to = "temp") %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(ROOMS, T_col, name), by = "T_col") %>%
  filter(date < min(date) + days(14))

p2a <- ggplot(temp_long, aes(x = date, y = temp, color = name)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = PAL$rooms[1:8]) +
  labs(title    = "All indoor room temperatures for the first 2 weeks",
       subtitle = "Overnight drops reveal empty rooms",
       x = NULL, y = "Temperature (°C)", color = "Room") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "right")
print(p2a)

# 2B. Temperature heatmaps — Kitchen (T1) and Bedroom 1 (T7)
for (room_i in c(1, 7)) {
  r   <- ROOMS[room_i, ]
  tmp <- df %>%
    mutate(date_only = as.Date(date), hr = hour(date)) %>%
    group_by(date_only, hr) %>%
    summarise(temp = mean(.data[[r$T_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  p <- ggplot(tmp, aes(x = hr, y = date_only, fill = temp)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = c("#2C7BB6","#ABD9E9","white","#FDAE61","#D7191C"),
      name = "°C") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 23, 3),
                       labels = sprintf("%02d:00", seq(0, 23, 3))) +
    labs(title    = sprintf("Temperature heatmap — %s (%s)", r$name, r$T_col),
         subtitle = "Blue = cool (empty/night)  •  Red = warm (occupied)",
         x = "Hour of day", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  print(p)
}

# 2C. Bathroom humidity heatmap
rh5 <- df %>%
```

 MODULE 3 OCCUPANCY SCORING
```{r}

indoor_rooms <- ROOMS %>% dplyr::filter(indoor)

occ_score_df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    dRH_out = RH_out - lag(RH_out, default = first(RH_out)),
    dT_out  = T_out  - lag(T_out,  default = first(T_out))
  )

for (i in 1:nrow(indoor_rooms)) {
  r         <- indoor_rooms[i, ]
  score_col <- paste0("occ_", r$id)
  
  occ_score_df <- occ_score_df %>%
    mutate(
      dRH_room  = .data[[r$RH_col]] - lag(.data[[r$RH_col]],
                                          default = first(.data[[r$RH_col]])),
      rh_signal = pmax(0, dRH_room - dRH_out),
      
      dT_room   = .data[[r$T_col]] - lag(.data[[r$T_col]],
                                         default = first(.data[[r$T_col]])),
      t_signal  = pmax(0, dT_room - dT_out),
      
      lights_sig = ifelse(r$id %in% c(1, 2, 4),
                          lights / max(lights, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
      
      !!score_col := pmin(1, pmax(0,
                                  0.4 * pmin(1, rh_signal / 3) +
                                    0.3 * pmin(1, t_signal  / 0.5) +
                                    0.3 * lights_sig
      ))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-dRH_room, -rh_signal, -dT_room, -t_signal, -lights_sig)
}

cat("Occupancy score columns created: occ_1 through occ_9\n\n")

# Hourly aggregation
occ_hourly <- occ_score_df %>%
  mutate(date_hour = floor_date(date, "hour")) %>%
  group_by(date_hour) %>%
  summarise(
    Appliances        = mean(Appliances),
    lights            = mean(lights),
    T_out             = mean(T_out),
    RH_out            = mean(RH_out),
    hour              = first(hour(date)),
    is_weekend        = first(ifelse(wday(date) %in% c(1, 7), 1, 0)),
    across(starts_with("occ_"), max),
    across(all_of(ROOMS$T_col[ROOMS$indoor]),  mean),
    across(all_of(ROOMS$RH_col[ROOMS$indoor]), mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    occ_house = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., starts_with("occ_")), na.rm = TRUE),
    lag1  = lag(Appliances, 1,  default = NA),
    lag24 = lag(Appliances, 24, default = NA),
    roll3 = (lag(Appliances, 1, default = NA) +
               lag(Appliances, 2, default = NA) +
               lag(Appliances, 3, default = NA)) / 3
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

cat(sprintf("Hourly rows after lag drop: %d\n\n", nrow(occ_hourly)))

# Plot 7 — per-room occupancy scores for the first 7 days
occ_plot_long <- occ_hourly %>%
  dplyr::select(date_hour, starts_with("occ_"), -occ_house) %>%
  pivot_longer(-date_hour, names_to = "room_id", values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(room_id = as.integer(str_remove(room_id, "occ_"))) %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(ROOMS, id, name), by = c("room_id" = "id"))

p3a <- occ_plot_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(date_hour < min(date_hour) + days(7)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date_hour, y = score, color = name)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~name, ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = PAL$rooms) +
  labs(title    = "Room occupancy scores for the first 7 days",
       subtitle = "Score 0–1 from RH rise, temperature rise, and lights",
       x = NULL, y = "Occupancy score", color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none")
print(p3a)

# Plot 8 — all-room occupancy matrix, first 3 weeks
occ_matrix <- occ_hourly %>%
  dplyr::select(date_hour, starts_with("occ_"), -occ_house) %>%
  dplyr::filter(date_hour < min(date_hour) + days(21)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-date_hour, names_to = "room_id", values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(room_id = as.integer(str_remove(room_id, "occ_"))) %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(ROOMS, id, name), by = c("room_id" = "id"))

p3b <- ggplot(occ_matrix,
              aes(x = date_hour, y = reorder(name, -room_id), fill = score)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#EFF3FF","#BDD7E7","#6BAED6","#2171B5","#08306B"),
    name = "Occupancy\nscore", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title    = "Room occupancy matrix for the first 3 weeks",
       subtitle = "Dark = occupied  •  Light = empty / asleep",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
print(p3b)
```

MODULE 5  FORECASTING


```{r}

split_i    <- floor(0.8 * nrow(occ_hourly))
train_data <- occ_hourly[1:split_i, ]
test_data  <- occ_hourly[(split_i + 1):nrow(occ_hourly), ]
actual     <- test_data$Appliances

cat(sprintf("Train: %d rows  |  Test: %d rows\n\n",
            nrow(train_data), nrow(test_data)))

# A. Seasonal naive baseline
pred_naive <- test_data$lag24

# B. SARIMAX
cat("[ B ] Fitting SARIMAX \n")
ts_train   <- ts(train_data$Appliances, frequency = 24)
xreg_cols  <- c("T_out", "RH_out", "is_weekend", "hour",
                "occ_house", "lag24")
xreg_train <- as.matrix(train_data[, xreg_cols])
xreg_test  <- as.matrix(test_data[,  xreg_cols])

model_sarimax <- auto.arima(ts_train, xreg = xreg_train,
                            seasonal = TRUE, stepwise = TRUE,
                            approximation = TRUE)
pred_sarimax  <- as.numeric(
  forecast(model_sarimax, xreg = xreg_test, h = nrow(test_data))$mean)
cat(sprintf("   SARIMAX order: ARIMA(%s)\n\n",
            paste(arimaorder(model_sarimax), collapse = ",")))

# C. Random Forest
cat("[ C ] Training Random Forest (200 trees)\n")
rf_features <- c("T_out","RH_out","hour","is_weekend",
                 "lag1","lag24","roll3",
                 "occ_house","occ_1","occ_2","occ_7","occ_8")

model_rf <- randomForest(
  as.formula(paste("Appliances ~", paste(rf_features, collapse = " + "))),
  data = train_data, ntree = 200, importance = TRUE
)
pred_rf <- predict(model_rf, newdata = test_data)
cat("   Done.\n\n")

# Metrics
mape_fn <- function(a, p) mean(abs((a - p) / a), na.rm = TRUE) * 100

results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Seasonal Naive", "SARIMAX", "Random Forest"),
  RMSE  = c(rmse(actual, pred_naive),
            rmse(actual, pred_sarimax),
            rmse(actual, pred_rf)),
  MAE   = c(mae(actual, pred_naive),
            mae(actual, pred_sarimax),
            mae(actual, pred_rf)),
  MAPE  = c(mape_fn(actual, pred_naive),
            mape_fn(actual, pred_sarimax),
            mape_fn(actual, pred_rf))
) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3)))


cat( "FINAL PERFORMANCE METRICS \n")
print(results, row.names = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("\nBest model (RMSE): %s\n\n",
            results$Model[which.min(results$RMSE)]))

# Plot 15 — all models vs actual

# Plot 19 — model comparison bars
results_long <- results %>%
  pivot_longer(c(RMSE, MAE, MAPE), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value")

p5e <- ggplot(results_long, aes(x = Model, y = Value, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Value, 2)),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
  facet_wrap(~Metric, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Seasonal Naive" = "#AAAAAA",
                               SARIMAX         = "#F46D43",
                               "Random Forest" = "#1A9641")) +
  labs(title    = "Model comparison — RMSE, MAE, MAPE",
       subtitle = "Lower is better",
       x = NULL, y = "Error") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))
print(p5e)

# Plot 20 — RF feature importance
imp_df <- importance(model_rf) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Feature") %>%
  arrange(desc(`%IncMSE`)) %>%
  mutate(Feature = fct_reorder(Feature, `%IncMSE`),
         type = case_when(
           str_detect(Feature, "occ")      ~ "Occupancy (bio-analytics)",
           str_detect(Feature, "lag|roll") ~ "Lag (temporal)",
           TRUE                            ~ "Context"
         ))

p5f <- ggplot(imp_df, aes(x = Feature, y = `%IncMSE`, fill = type)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Occupancy (bio-analytics)" = "#2171B5",
                               "Lag (temporal)"           = "#1A9641",
                               "Context"                  = "#AAAAAA")) +
  labs(title    = "RF feature importance ?",
       subtitle = "Blue = occupancy scores ",
       x = NULL, y = "% increase in MSE", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "top")
print(p5f)
```
